messages.source: 把课表与日程写入系统日历里的专属日历「OneTHU 日程」（不影响你已有的日历）。开启后自动更新课表、未提交作业与日程；课程与考试提前 15 分钟提醒，作业按提醒设置提前。macOS 日历可能随系统账户同步到其他设备。旧版本的同名日历请核对后自行清理。{value}
messages.translation: Writes your timetable and schedules into a dedicated calendar "OneTHU Schedule" in the system calendar (your existing calendars are not touched). Once enabled, the timetable, unsubmitted assignments, and schedules are updated automatically. Classes and exams are reminded 15 minutes ahead; assignments follow the reminder settings. macOS calendars may sync to other devices with the system account. If a same-named calendar from an older version exists, review and clean it up yourself. {value}

messages.translation: Use your Tsinghua email's calendar service to sync manually added schedules across devices — schedules added in OneTHU appear in the system calendar / other devices signed in with the same account. To get an app password: webmail (mails.tsinghua.edu.cn) → Settings → client-specific password. {value}

messages.source:
在 iPhone / iPad 上查看日程（可选）

手机上没有 OneTHU 也没关系：日程已在你清华邮箱的云端日历里，在 iPhone/iPad 上添加同一邮箱即可看到：
· 设置 → 日历 → 账户 → 添加账户 → 其他 → CalDAV 账户
· 服务器地址：https://mails.tsinghua.edu.cn/coremail/dav/users/你的邮箱/
· 用户名：完整邮箱；密码：客户端专用密码（与本页一致）

本机不需要此设置——用下方「系统日历同步」一键开启即可，应用直接写系统日历。
messages.translation:
View schedules on iPhone / iPad (optional)

It is fine if OneTHU is not on your phone: your schedules are already in the cloud calendar of your Tsinghua email. Add the same email account on iPhone/iPad to see them:
· Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → CalDAV Account
· Server: https://mails.tsinghua.edu.cn/coremail/dav/users/your-email/
· Username: full email; Password: client-specific password (same as on this page)

This setup is not needed on this device — just turn on "System calendar sync" below and the app writes the system calendar directly.
